subject: physics
content:
A uniform electric field, NC−1 is applied in a region. A charged particle of mass m carrying positive charge q is projected in this region with an initial speed of 2 106 ms−1 . This particle is aimed to hit a target T, which is 5 m away from its entry point into the field as shown schematically in the figure.
Take = 1010 Ckg−1 . Then

options.content:
the particle will hit T if projected at an angle 45<sup>o</sup>
from the horizontal

the particle will hit T if projected either at an angle 30<sup>o</sup> or 60<sup>o</sup>
from the horizontal
